text: {"lessons":["Selling winners gave me satisfaction, but a gain over my cost alone does not justify selling; I should consider each holding’s prospects and role in the portfolio.","My reluctance to realize losses can keep me attached to a purchase. Cost is sunk, so I should judge whether a position still merits its place based on current risks and expected returns.","I traded rarely and did not react to recent declines, which is sensible when price changes are unpredictable. I should keep a diversified, deliberate plan rather than chase short-term moves."]}
